title: 4 Street Food to try in Chandni Chowk Delhi 🤤
description: In this Shorts video, Backpacker Indian is sharing 4 Healthy Indian Street Food to try in Chandni Chowk Delhi a.k.a Delhi 06. Old Delhi is filled with a number of unseen delicacies and now whether it be Besan Papdi Chaat or Moth Chaat or Nostalgic Candy, Purani Dilli has everything. Watch till the end of this shorts to find out what all he had under 200 rupees budget.
